title: CAT Question Record
description: One CAT practice question, used as an ML/LLM dataset example for generating more similar questions. One JSON object per line in the .jsonl files.

id.description: Unique, stable id for the question.

topicId.description: Curriculum topic id — must match an id in src/data/curriculum.js (e.g. 'qa_tsd').

tags.description: Topic tags copied from the curriculum (e.g. ['Arithmetic']).

type.description: MCQ = 4 options with one correct letter. TITA = type-in-the-answer (no options).

question.description: Full, self-contained question text. For RC/DILR, embed the passage or data inside this field.

options.description: Exactly 4 options like 'A) ...' for MCQ; empty [] for TITA.

correct.description: 'A'|'B'|'C'|'D' for MCQ; the exact answer string for TITA.

concept.description: The single concept / technique the question tests.

source.description: Provenance: pyqBank | official | captured | seed | manual.

reference.description: Citation for what this question is modeled on, e.g. 'CAT 2025 Slot 2' — empty if purely AI-generated.
